title: Burgman 200 Maxi (Classic Heritage)
description: The Suzuki Burgman 200 Maxi (Classic Heritage) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 200cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
